_comment: Shared case table for the TransportError class (d-685d09). Read by framework/tests/test_transport_error_rule.py AND leaderboard-app/lib/__tests__/unscoreable-parity.test.ts, so the Python and Node classifiers are held to the same answers. transport=true means the failure is the provider's or the network's (HTTP 429 / 5xx / connection), never the model's answer; sanitized is what framework.holdout.sanitize_error (and build-data.mjs sanitizeError) must reduce the message to on a held-out record.

cases.error: RuntimeError: ccf-groq-gpt-oss-120b: OpenAI-compatible endpoint returned HTTP 429: {"error":{"message":"Rate limit reached for model on tokens per day (TPD)"}}
RuntimeError: ccf-gemini-flash-lite-latest: Gemini returned HTTP 429: {"error":{"code":429,"status":"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}}
RuntimeError: p: OpenAI-compatible endpoint returned HTTP 503: upstream unavailable
RuntimeError: p: OpenAI-compatible endpoint returned HTTP 500:
HTTPError: 429 Client Error: Too Many Requests for url: https://example.invalid/v1/chat/completions
HTTPError: 502 Server Error: Bad Gateway for url: https://example.invalid/v1
ConnectionError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='x', port=443): Max retries exceeded
cases.why: a connection type keeps its own name

cases.error: ConnectionResetError: [WinError 10054] An existing connection was forcibly closed
ChunkedEncodingError: ('Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)')
TransportError
cases.why: the class itself, as stored on a held-out record

cases.error: RuntimeError: cohere-command-a-pubbias: OpenAI-compatible endpoint returned HTTP 422: {"error_type":"NO_VALID_RESPONSE_GENERATED"}
cases.why: 422 = the provider says the MODEL produced nothing valid; live record in publication-bias-v1

cases.error: RuntimeError: p: OpenAI-compatible endpoint returned HTTP 400: context length exceeded
cases.why: 4xx other than 429 is a request problem, not a transient one

cases.error: HTTPError: 404 Client Error: Not Found for url: https://example.invalid
RuntimeError
cases.why: a held-out record redacted before this class existed: cause unknown, stays as it was

cases.error: RuntimeError: claude exited 1: boom
ValueError: no parseable JSON in CLI output (len=40): 'returned HTTP 503 so I stopped'
cases.why: model text quoted after the second ': ' must never excuse the answer

cases.error: ValueError: no parseable JSON in CLI output (len=40): 'p: x returned HTTP 429: y'
output_schema_violation: /verdict: 'returned HTTP 429' is not one of ['supported']
cases.why: a rejected answer is the model's, whatever it quotes

cases.error: ValueError: invalid connection string in config
cases.why: the word 'connection' in free text is not a transport failure

cases.error: GROBID isalive returned 503
cases.why: not an exception-shaped message; local tool health, outside this class
